value.content: {"id": "recon_meth_004", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "name": "JavaScript Bundle Analysis & Client-Side Secret Detection", "prerequisites": ["javascript_parsing", "regex_pattern_matching"], "signals": ["javascript_bundles", "source_maps", "hardcoded_api_keys", "developer_comments", "internal_api_routes"], "verification_strategy": "Inspect publicly served JavaScript assets and unpack available source maps. Apply entropy scanning and regex patterns for hardcoded credentials, cloud access tokens, and private API routing tables.", "evidence_requirements": ["identified_secret_signature", "js_file_line_reference", "exposed_endpoint_path"], "remediation_pattern": "Never store secrets, private API tokens, or internal credentials in client-side code. Recovers hidden REST/GraphQL endpoints, undocumented parameters, and accidentally committed credentials."}
